name: fast-decide-compaction
description: Verbatim context compaction with Mercury Decide (OpenRouter). Keeps what the work still needs word for word; fidelity and economy modes.

apiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
apiKey.description: Your own OpenRouter API key. Leave unset to use the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Newest messages never touched (default 40; economy mode uses 10 plus a character tail).

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Percent of the model's context window at which compaction starts (default 67).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: economy (default): compact at the trigger, keep the newest 2% of the window whole and trim to about 4%, so a long session costs less per turn. fidelity: keep far more of the history (costs more per turn).

reuseMinHits.title: Reuse minimum hits
reuseMinHits.description: Distinct identifiers of a result that must reappear later for it to be kept regardless of Decide.

reuseBudgetChars.title: Reuse budget (characters)
reuseBudgetChars.description: Most characters of extra results the reuse check may keep.

preserveRecentPercent.title: Newest percent of window kept whole
preserveRecentPercent.description: Keep every message in the newest N% of the model's context window (economy mode: 2).

targetPercent.title: Target size, percent of window
targetPercent.description: Trim the compacted history to about N% of the model's context window (economy mode: 4). 0 = off.

extractCited.title: Extract cited lines from results
extractCited.description: Experimental, no measured gain: keep only the lines of long kept tool results that contain identifiers the later conversation cites.

extractOldText.title: Extract cited lines from old assistant text
extractOldText.description: Experimental, no measured gain: same line extraction for long old assistant messages.

archive.title: Archive dropped tool output
archive.description: Save the full text of shortened tool results under ~/.claude/fast-decide-archive and point to it, so the agent can read it back instead of re-running the tool.

activityIndex.title: List dropped tool calls
activityIndex.description: Add one short message listing every dropped tool call (tool and key argument) so the agent knows what was already done.
